name: How long does a rotted window sill replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a rotted window sill replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for a rotted window sill replacement varies based on the extent of the damage and the number of sills. A single sill replacement with minor rot typically takes a professional a few hours to a full day. If there is significant underlying structural damage that needs repair, or if multiple sills are being replaced, the project could extend over several days. An on-site assessment provides the most accurate timeline.
